final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT x.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id, a.district_id FROM disp AS d JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id) AS links JOIN district AS x ON x.district_id = links.district_id GROUP BY x.A3), shares AS (SELECT client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), compared AS (SELECT client_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
